seed: A marker on the ruler under a real pointer, at Next defaults with no flag set: pressed on its flag and dragged, it moves to where the pointer let go, as one step to undo. The ruler is about 194 pt a second from 0:00 at x 160 in a window this size (measured off clips-snap-to-markers-walk's pictures).

steps.note: M dropped a marker at 0:02 and the playhead was parked at 0:06.5, out of the way
a real press on the marker's flag at 0:02, dragged along the ruler to about 0:04 and let go: the marker moved there, the playhead stayed at 0:06.5, and no range was drawn
one undo put the marker back at 0:02
